the cost to set up the solution worldwide: the cost of a platform change and its enforcement

the share of the loss of populism that the solution avoids if it is fully in place: the largest share of all populism solutions, because hiding an emotional post with one click slows the spread of populist messages on every platform at once and at almost no cost (see fermi_internet_pro_contra.json); less social media exposure lowers polarization: in a randomised experiment, people who switched off Facebook for four weeks before the 2018 US election became less politically polarized (Allcott et al. 2020)
the cost to set up the solution worldwide: the cost of a curriculum change and teacher training in most countries

the share of the loss of populism that the solution avoids if it is fully in place: one of the bigger shares, because it works against the demand for simple answers; Italians who grew up with entertainment TV instead of learning content became less cognitively sophisticated and civic-minded adults and more open to populist rhetoric (Durante et al. 2019)
the cost to set up the solution worldwide: the cost of teaching material and teacher training in most countries

the share of the loss of populism that the solution avoids if it is fully in place: a medium share, because it reduces the effect of disinformation on voters; a short set of tips on how to spot false news improved the ability to tell true from false headlines by 26 percent in the US, and the effect was still measurable weeks later (Guess et al. 2020)
the cost to set up the solution worldwide: the cost of independent fact-checking teams for the large languages

the share of the loss of populism that the solution avoids if it is fully in place: a small share, because a check reaches fewer people than the claim and is often rejected by the target group; fact-checks of Trump claims in 2016 corrected the factual beliefs even of his supporters but had no measurable effect on their view of Trump (Nyhan et al. 2019)
the cost to set up the solution worldwide: the cost of infrastructure and services for the lagging regions of many countries
